name: T2 learned-operator preflight and T3 cached GDN state probe
purpose: Continue T2/T3 after validation object binding by producing real learned-operator artifacts for preflight wiring and measuring W3 on the actual Qwen3.5 cached GDN recurrent state.

code_added_used.change: Added a weight-tied recurrent operator trainer that generates real Sudoku6 L1-L2 train/eval examples, evaluates held-out G1/G2, samples L4 and 9x9 anchor bins, writes a learned_recurrent checkpoint, and emits acceptance.json with explicit object/source labels.
Implemented a real 9x9 Sudoku generator backed by DPLLOracle instead of an empty stub so T2 can record external-anchor generation.
Reduced oversized sampling attempts for large generated batches while retaining a bounded retry policy.
Added --learned-operator-acceptance, records learned acceptance metadata in preflight, and uses the acceptance checkpoint as the Stage A operator checkpoint when supplied.

Added true DynamicCache cached_gdn_recurrent_state inventory, perturb/restore round trip, cached-state decay survival, cached-state native-rule-gap tables, and cached-state integration-grade verdicts.

commands.purpose: Smoke-tested the T2 trainer and acceptance artifact path.
Reconstructed Stage A bridge decoder and teacher trace artifacts in this repo so preflight can bind to real local files.
Verified Stage A preflight uses the learned checkpoint from acceptance and reaches READY once bridge decoder and teacher trace exist.
Regenerated canonical W3 artifact on the actual Qwen3.5 cached GDN recurrent state.

provenance.formal_t2_run: started with train_instances=4096 eval_instances=512 l4_instances=128 steps=300 on cuda:0; final metrics pending while this item was drafted

honesty.does_not_establish: The T2 smoke checkpoint does not meet G1>=0.95 and does not produce autonomous Stage A cells. The formal T2 run was launched but final metrics were not available at item creation time. W3 now measures the right cached object for round-trip, survival, and native-rule gap, but W3.2 propagation delta remains NOT_RUN.
limitations: Stage A run_shard still records learned-operator availability but does not execute a full autonomous backtracking loop.
T2 G1 remains unaccepted until a formal run reaches threshold.
W3.2 qwen3-vs-qwen3.5 propagation delta still needs per-task execution before final integration claims.

gate_outcomes.number: operator, bridge decoder, teacher trace, and module1 capacity present

decision.next_step_routing: Wait for the formal T2 trainer to finish, rerun validation, and only promote T2 if G1>=0.95 and autonomous Stage A cells are produced. Then run W3.2 propagation delta on cached-state-linked outputs.
